parsed.explanation: Combined federal and state rules make entry documents the primary exposure: passport/visa mismatch, marker restrictions, possible refusal or lifetime inadmissibility. If detained, immigration/correction custody documents abuse, birth-sex placement and conversion-style treatment. State school/college facility mandates and minor outing/care restrictions add tier-1 exposure for families. Local and employment protections do not offset operative border, detention or facility rules.

entry_documents.exposure: Executive order bars self-selected sex markers on passports/visas; discrepancies or evidence casting reasonable doubt on sex trigger refusal/additional evidence; suspected misrepresentation can support permanent inadmissibility. Reports say passports blocked/confiscated and travellers stranded; foreign advisories cite visa detentions. Airport/security screening can expose mismatch via secondary checks or pat-downs.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiration; ongoing litigation/legal-aid FAQ. No documented operative protection against border screening, marker doubt, or fraud findings.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-passport mismatch becomes national entry investigation; valid X marker does not guarantee clearance and can escalate to refusal, delay, or custody.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse; corrections adopted conversion-style inmate rules and hormone denial; a state bathroom arrest led to 24h men's ward. Fraud/lifetime bar increases stakes if outed.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Some orders enjoined; national employment/hate-crime laws are climate signals; no custody protocol, consular access, or traveler-facing detention protection documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry discrepancy can move traveller into detention; birth-sex placement and care denial make custody the severe consequence.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National order bars congruent use of government-funded single-sex facilities; state law requires K-12/college public/private bathrooms, locker rooms, showers and overnight accommodation by birth sex; students must use birth-certificate marker.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Single-occupancy controlled exemptions; other states/municipalities lack mapped bans. No documented enforcement that protects visitors; absence of penalty does not remove designation.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Campus visits, school events, youth programs and government buildings can expose presentation/document mismatch; school enrolment forces facilities conflict.

care_services.exposure: Youth care and sports restrictions are enacted or in contested override; national rules direct investigation/prosecution of school staff facilitating transition; proposed insurance bars target minors. Adult care was not in force after dropped rules.
care_services.protection: Some courts blocked provisions; no documented traveller emergency-care protection, continuity of HRT, or care-access shield for visiting families.
care_services.interaction: Care-seeking, school enrolment, or emergency treatment can reveal status and trigger denial, reporting, or guardian inquiry.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Counterterrorism language names radically pro-transgender groups; national orders use radical gender ideology framing, direct school investigations, and document/athletics restrictions; polling supports assigned-sex documents. A state bathroom arrest shows enforcement.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National employment law, hate-crime statute and city ordinances show partial legal coverage; not documented as effective for travellers at entry, facilities or custody.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat framing and hostile policy encourage border, school and police actors to doubt, exclude or detain trans presentation.

minors_guardians.exposure: State facility law forces birth-sex school/college facilities and overnight accommodation; school law mandates disclosing LGBTQ status to parents; curriculum bans and sports/care rules expose minors. Guardian travel can require proof and school placement.
minors_guardians.protection: Single-occupancy exemption; some local protections; no operative family shield for short visits, enrolment or care needs.
minors_guardians.interaction: Parent/guardian encounters school or care systems; child documents/presentation can trigger refusal, outing, custody or separation.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No trans-specific street violence rate or visitor harassment dataset documented; but police response to facilities/care may detain or out traveller, as shown by bathroom arrest and custody reports.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Hate-crime coverage and some local anti-discrimination exist; no documented police protection for foreign or outed visitors.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Street risk is unknown; documented exposure is institutional response, not a verified public-violence campaign.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Operative status of care/sports, motor-vehicle marker rules, county marker refusals and school enforcement is unclear; many national orders remain in effect or litigated, so traveller cannot predict protections.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Litigation, injunctions, legal-aid FAQ and limited employment/hate-crime coverage may help residents; no reliable short-stay remedy documented for entry, facilities or custody.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Uncertainty increases risk because travellers cannot know what rule applies at border, detention, or school; remedies usually require time not available.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar border/visa document regime and custody abuse, but no documented arrest-for-presentation statute or execution path. National facility mandates and lifetime inadmissibility add severity, keeping it near the low 0.10s.

0.25-C has birth-sex prison placement and cross-dressing arrest. This dossier is worse because entry documents, federal facilities, immigration custody abuse and minor school mandates create broad universal exposure, not isolated custody.

0.75-C allows matching passport markers, trained border officers and detention remedies. This jurisdiction reverses all three: markers can trigger refusal/fraud, detention can become abuse, and traveler-facing remedies are not documented.

parsed.synthesis: The operative regime is one integrated system: national document/entry screening is hostile, and state facility and school rules reinforce birth-sex control. A traveller presenting differently from a passport faces doubt at border, refusal, delay, possible lifetime inadmissibility, and, if detained, documented abuse, solitary, sexual violence, hormone denial, and conversion-style custody. Families face school/college facility exclusion, mandated outing, care restrictions, and teacher prosecution threats. Partial employment protections, injunctions and legal-aid guidance do not offset traveller-facing border, custody or school exposure; therefore the rating sits in the severe-risk range well below Reduced Risk.
